title: Compiz wobbly windows and cube
blurb: Compiz Fusion's 2006 spring-mesh wobbly windows and translucent 4-face 3D desktop cube built on live HTML windows inside one WebGL 2 canvas. Drag the titlebar to stretch the 4 by 4 Bezier grid, or spin the cube and click straight into whichever workspace faces you.
question: Can I recreate Compiz Fusion's 2006 spring-mesh wobbly windows and translucent 4-face 3D desktop cube on live HTML windows inside one WebGL 2 canvas, keeping inputs and buttons clickable during and after deformation?
result: Built on one ElementGL WebGL 2 context with a 4 by 4 Bezier spring-mass grid tessellated into a 20 by 20 triangle mesh, a 4-face translucent 3D desktop cube with floor reflection, updateElementGeometry() hit-box tracking, a 2D canvas fallback and plain HTML context-loss recovery. Live browser runs on Chromium 157 and Chrome 159 for Android are not verified yet.
